verdict.rationale: Ledgy's compliance pages describe generic 'one-click equity compliance reports' and automated error flags. Nothing in the evidence mentions Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections, or any US-specific filing generation from the cap table. That generic compliance reporting is adjacent to this story and does not show it delivers the named US filings.

support.subject: As an ops user, US equity compliance — Rule 701 disclosure thresholds, Form 3921 filings, 83(b) elections — is tracked and generated from the cap table automatically
